_comment: Copy this file to users.json (git-ignored) and put your real logins in it. Keys the launcher reads: env, class, login, password, run-tests. Anything else - like this comment - is ignored.

env is the environment this user belongs to: a URL or host:port. --env selects it by short name (--env=localhost), supplies its URL so --url is optional, and names the profile folder <env>-<login>. The env+login pair must be unique.

The same login can repeat under a different env - that is how one user set covers several environments, each with its own profile and its own scenarios. run-tests takes scenario ids or tag:NAME selectors, and --run-tests=config gives each window its own list.
